name: @project-play/reservations-supabase
description: Supabase repository adapter and SQL setup assets for Project Play reservation packages.
author: Project Play maintainers

scripts.prepack: pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-core run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api run build && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-core run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --import tsx --test
